mapper.select: SELECT to_char(w.work_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS workdayDate, w.work_type AS dayType, COALESCE(w.work_name, '') AS dayName, COALESCE(w.work_memo, '') AS memo, COALESCE(w.work_source, 'PATTERN') AS source FROM tb_workdate w WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.work_date >= make_date(#{year}, 1, 1) AND w.work_date < make_date(#{year} + 1, 1, 1) ORDER BY w.work_date
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_workdate WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND work_date >= make_date(#{year}, 1, 1) AND work_date < make_date(#{year} + 1, 1, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_workdate SET work_type = #{dayType}, work_name = #{dayName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, work_memo = #{memo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, work_source = 'MANUAL', updated_by = #{updatedBy, jdbcType=BIGINT}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND work_date = CAST(#{workdayDate} AS DATE)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_workdate (tenant_id, work_date, work_type, work_source, work_name, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, CAST(#{workdayDate} AS DATE), #{dayType}, #{source}, #{dayName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{operatorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, work_date) DO UPDATE SET work_type = EXCLUDED.work_type, work_source = EXCLUDED.work_source, work_name = EXCLUDED.work_name, updated_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tb_workdate.work_source IS DISTINCT FROM 'MANUAL'

INSERT INTO tb_week (tenant_id, year, week, from_date, to_date, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{year}, #{week}, CAST(#{fromDate} AS DATE), CAST(#{toDate} AS DATE), #{operatorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, year, week) DO UPDATE SET from_date = EXCLUDED.from_date, to_date = EXCLUDED.to_date, updated_by = EXCLUDED.created_by, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT k.year AS year, k.week AS week, to_char(k.from_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fromDate, to_char(k.to_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS toDate FROM tb_week k WHERE k.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND k.from_date <= CAST(#{to} AS DATE) AND k.to_date >= CAST(#{from} AS DATE) ORDER BY k.from_date
SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{value} LIMIT 1
